title: ammi majus var. intermedium
intro: Ammi majus var. intermedium, commonly known as False Queen Anne's Lace, is a plant species within the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as its ability to support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which are believed to be a result of its bioactive constituents, including volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents present in Ammi majus var. intermedium have been studied for their potential use in treating various health conditions, including wound healing, antimicrobial infections, and cardiovascular diseases.
